description_en: Upscales e-commerce images by intelligently enhancing resolution and details, improving textures and image quality during the upscaling process. Supports high-definition outputs such as 2K and 4K to meet the requirements for product main images, detail images, and marketing materials, and enables efficient processing of large batches of images to improve overall image quality. (Synchronous)
description_zh: 高清放大产品专为电商图片定制，智能提升图片分辨率与细节表现，在放大过程中增强纹理、优化画质，支持 2K、4K 等高清输出，满足商品主图、细节图及营销素材的高清化需求，实现大批量图片的高效、清晰处理，提升商品图片质量。（同步）
name: ImageUpscale

parameters.help_en: The URL of the original image. It must be a publicly accessible image URL. You cannot use private network addresses such as localhost. The width and height of the input image must be greater than 100 pixels and less than 3000 pixels. The width and height of the upscaled image must not exceed 3000 pixels
parameters.help_zh: 原图 URL，必须为公网可访问的图片地址，不能使用 localhost 等私网地址。输入图片宽高均须大于 100 像素、小于 3000 像素。放大后宽高均不得超过 3000 像素
parameters.name: image_url

parameters.help_en: The upscaling factor of the image. Valid values: 2 and 4. Default value: 2
parameters.help_zh: 图片放大倍数，支持 2、4。未设置时默认放大 2 倍
parameters.name: upscale_factor
